name: evalme
description: A local-first, append-only capability measurement system for humans, organized like agent evals: tasks with preregistered graders, transcripts, per-check blind verdicts, and an evidence chain from every conclusion back to a line in the transcript.

interface.shortDescription: Measure yourself like an agent eval: task bank → trial → blind grading → evidence-chained health per topic.
interface.longDescription: A local-first, append-only capability measurement system for humans. Define topics (weights + label vocabulary), create tasks with preregistered behavior-anchored graders, practice from the bank (prompt-only hosting, notarized transcripts, derived novelty), grade blind per-check in a fresh context, then review: deterministic assess, an evidence chain down to transcript lines, novelty-layered pass rates, stale markers, and a task picker. No numeric score lines — passing is extensional (recent pass rate on unseen/variant tasks). Every projection is byte-for-byte recomputable. v1 scope: backend system-design interviews.
defaultPrompt: Create a new idempotency task for my weakest topic.
Practice a task from my bank and record the trial.
Explain my idempotency health with the evidence chain.
